operationsSourceRevision: The Git commit containing this evidence and infrastructure/production/shared-vps.

route: Two API replicas and protected media

dns.name: api
dns.originalHostnameStatus: Not publicly delegated at deployment; replacement explicitly requested by the user

runtimeIdentityCheck.note: Store and membership directory authorization is enforced by authenticated server transactions; these metadata tables are not declared as RLS tables by the migrations.

database.rlsScope: All 19 FORCE RLS tables declared by the deployed migrations were checked. Store/membership directory authorization is enforced by server transactions, not PostgreSQL RLS on those metadata tables.

identityAndSmtp.inboxReceipt: pending first explicitly authorized real invitation/recovery email

checks: repeated final upload chunk accepted without duplicate file
processed size and SHA-256 match metadata
206 Range and If-Range/ETag return expected bytes
Cloudflare response is not HIT, STALE or UPDATING

backupAndMonitoring.sshStdinRegression: passed: caller continued after both backup and restore without caller-side stdin redirects
healthChecks: no failed, stale or overdue jobs
public HTTPS health and trusted certificate
origin certificate valid beyond seven days

localVerification.applicationTestRerun: No new backend/mobile business change in this deployment; earlier application evidence remains in tests/audit/final-evidence-2026-09-22.json.

resolvedDuringDeployment: Original domain was not delegated; switched to api.galylio.com with explicit user authorization.
Existing Apache owns 80/443; used a scoped vhost and loopback Nginx without interrupting other sites.
A 2 GiB global media quota cannot admit video reserving 2 GiB plus source; raised to 4 GiB before final successful processing.
Cloudflare browser integrity check rejects generic Python urllib (1010). The harness identifies itself honestly; actual Dart and BioBalance clients pass without disabling Cloudflare protection.
Docker exec in backup scripts could consume later SSH shell input. Closed stdin for non-input exec calls and verified both scripts through an SSH heredoc.

An initial RLS diagnostic incorrectly assumed directory metadata tables had RLS. The final checker derives required RLS tables from deployed migrations; all 19 pass, with metadata authorization scope explicitly documented.
Local and remote Docker image stores expose different image IDs. Verified identical filesystem layers, runtime configuration, operating system and architecture instead of claiming equal IDs.
remainingReleaseWork: Rebuild and qualify signed Android releases with this real API endpoint; Play/private APK distribution checks.
macOS/Xcode, Apple signing and native iOS validation.
Physical Android 4 GB and iOS profiling/accessibility/camera checks, real mobile networks and the invited pilot.
Representative full-stack load testing on this shared VPS and storage expansion/capacity review before broad rollout.
Independent external monitoring and alert routing.
Coordinated shared-host maintenance, including the already pending OS reboot; no global SSH changes made.
Mobile domain associations are not enabled on this replacement hostname; manual activation/recovery codes remain available.
limits: No claim of zero vulnerabilities, physical performance acceptance, 500-store capacity or complete server-loss recovery. VPS-local backups cannot recover destruction or loss of the VPS.
